  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "INTO A COPPER BOWL PUT {{ing_01|6 SEXTARII of HONEY}} AND {{ing_02|2 SEXTARII of WINE}}; HEAT ON A SLOW FIRE, CONSTANTLY STIRRING THE MIXTURE WITH A WHIP."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "AT THE BOILING POINT ADD {{ing_03|A DASH of COLD WINE}}, RETIRE FROM STOVE AND SKIM."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "REPEAT THIS TWICE OR THREE TIMES, LET IT REST TILL THE NEXT DAY, AND SKIM AGAIN."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "THEN ADD {{ing_04|4 OZS. of CRUSHED PEPPER}}, {{ing_05|3 SCRUPLES of MASTICH}}, {{ing_06|A DRACHM each of [nard or laurel] LEAVES}} AND {{ing_07|SAFFRON}}, {{ing_08|5 DRACHMS of ROASTED DATE STONES CRUSHED and PREVIOUSLY SOAKED IN WINE}} TO SOFTEN THEM."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "WHEN THIS IS PROPERLY DONE ADD {{ing_09|18 SEXTARII of LIGHT WINE}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "TO CLARIFY IT PERFECTLY, ADD {{ing_10|[crushed] CHARCOAL}} TWICE OR AS OFTEN AS NECESSARY WHICH WILL DRAW [the residue] TOGETHER [and carefully strain or filter through the charcoal]."
    }
